runbook: R-18 / R-19 (fresh independent oracle; evidence tree = git archive HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md only)

evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

sources_quoted.locator: {{rd|melee|ranged}} template convention, cross-checked on entries with independently known values
sources_quoted.quote: Ravenous Hydra / Tiamat 'Cleave': {{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}; Titanic Hydra 'Cleave': {{rd|1%|{{fd|0.5}}%}} maximum health; Blade of the Ruined King 'Mist's Edge': {{rd|9%|6%}} of the target's current health
sources_quoted.conclusion: first argument = melee holder, second = ranged holder. Therefore Expose Weakness = 8% (melee Bloodsong holder) / 5% (ranged).

sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)  [flat reduction -> % reduction -> % penetration -> flat penetration]

the established model uses a fixed 0.8*max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes.

Black Cleaver: stack-transform-summon-resource.stack 'Carve' + damage.resistance-mitigation 'Carve' (relations: damage.damage-instance, damage.armor-penetration). Bloodsong is item id 3877, a Spellblade support-quest upgrade (200 health, 9 gold/10, no combat stats beyond the proc).

independent_computation.note: The golden scenario's own configuration (champions, levels, builds, event ledger) lives in scripts/, which this runbook forbids reading. The computation is therefore done on the leaf's implied multiplicative delta, which is identifiable without the scenario config: a single damage event's value can only move by a resistance change or a damage-modifier change, and both families have closed forms quoted above (S4-S6).

step_1_implied_ratio.reading: the event's damage was multiplied by a factor in [1.07966, 1.08187]

step_2_candidate_A_expose_weakness.hypothesis: the event, dealt by a roster member other than / in addition to the Bloodsong holder, now receives Expose Weakness's 'increased damage from all sources' amplifier (S1), applied multiplicatively on the damage instance (S4).
step_2_candidate_A_expose_weakness.test: 1.08 lies inside the implied band [1.07966, 1.08187]; 1.05 lies far outside.
step_2_candidate_A_expose_weakness.rounding_consistency: if the unrounded old value u in [94.1204, 94.15) then 1.08*u in [101.650, 101.682) -> displays 101.7, while u displays 94.1. Self-consistent; no other sourced constant in the two named items lands inside the band.

step_3_candidate_B_black_cleaver.hypothesis: the delta comes from Black Cleaver armor reduction instead (S3), i.e. R_old -> R_new with damage ratio (100+R_old)/(100+R_new) per S5.
step_3_candidate_B_black_cleaver.algebra: let S = pen-adjusted armor before % reduction = (A - r_flat)*(1 - p), f = flat pen, x = Carve reduction fraction, so R = S*(1-x) - f (S6). Requiring (100+R_old)/(100+R_new) = 1.08077 gives R_old - R_new = k*(100+R_old) with k = (r-1)/r = 0.0747296.

sub_case_documented_cesaro_upgrade.change: average stacks 0.8*5 = 4 (x_old = 24%) -> at most 5 stacks (x_new <= 30%), i.e. delta_x <= 0.06 (S7)
sub_case_documented_cesaro_upgrade.conclusion: requires >1600 armor. IMPOSSIBLE - the documented BC stack-model refinement cannot produce an 8% jump on any real target.

sub_case_cleaver_off_to_full.conclusion: would require the target's pen-adjusted armor to be ~23-33, i.e. a level-1-grade squishy. Possible only in a narrow, implausible window (+/-1 armor), and it would additionally require Carve to have been entirely absent from the old ledger of a scenario named 'cleaver_...'. REJECTED as the explanation.

sub_case_single_stack_steps.solve: one extra 6% step: (100+S-f) = 1.08077*(100+0.94*S-f) has no non-negative solution; two extra steps need S ~ 161 with zero pen and exactly 12% reduction added - not reachable from the 4-stack constant model (max +1 stack, S7).

step_4_candidate_C_spellblade_row.hypothesis: the delta is Bloodsong's Spellblade on-hit (100% base AD, S1) newly added to this event.
step_4_candidate_C_spellblade_row.test: delta = 101.7 - 94.1 = 7.6 post-mitigation; against any realistic armor (60-160) that implies raw 12-20, versus a base AD of 50-70 for any champion in data/champions.json. Wrong order of magnitude, and a Spellblade row would be its own event, not a multiplicative rescale of a pair event.

step_5_conclusion.identified_mechanic: Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness': target takes 8% increased damage from ALL SOURCES for 4 s (melee holder).
step_5_conclusion.why_old_is_wrong: the old leaf carried the un-amplified damage, i.e. the roster-wide 'from all sources' clause of S1 was not being applied to this pair's damage event; the wiki text is explicit that the debuff sits on the TARGET and amplifies every source, not only the Bloodsong holder's own damage.
step_5_conclusion.why_new_is_right: the new leaf equals the old one times exactly the wiki-sourced 8% amplifier, applied multiplicatively as S4 requires; the factor is inside the 0.1-display rounding band and no competing sourced constant is.

residual_assumptions_and_falsifiers: The 8% branch of {{rd|8%|5%}} is the MELEE holder's value (S2). If the scenario's Bloodsong carrier is a ranged champion, the sourced amplifier is 5% and the correct leaf would be ~98.8 - in that case BOTH values would be wrong. This is the single unverifiable input, because the scenario roster is defined in scripts/ (out of bounds for this runbook). Bloodsong is the Spellblade (100% base AD) branch of the support-quest line, which is the melee/AD-support pick, so the melee branch is the strongly favoured reading.

Assumes event[62] falls inside a live 4 s Expose Weakness window and after the 1.5 s proc cooldown; timestamps are not visible from data/. The observed factor being exactly the amplifier is itself the evidence that the engine placed it inside the window.
Assumes the golden leaf is displayed at 0.1 precision (both values carry one decimal). All band arithmetic above uses that assumption.
